units.source_text: 麦苗呈现一片斑白的颜色。

en.t: The wheat seedlings showed a mottled whitish color.

units.source_text: 山峰上空明亮起来，候鸟不知为什么不愿在竹林中停留，从下游飞向远方去了。

en.t: The sky above the mountain peaks grew bright, and for some reason the migratory birds would not linger in the bamboo grove; they flew away from downstream into the distance.

units.source_text: 第二个汉子踩灭了竹林中的篝火，忽然蹲了下来，说：“喂，有人来了。”

en.t: The second man stamped out the bonfire in the bamboo grove, suddenly crouched down, and said, "Hey, someone is coming."
